text:
devon: FYI incoming support ticket — customer sees 400 from /v1/rerank, they pasted the payload and error.

devon: customer payload (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-...' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"items":[], "top_k": null, "candidates": "[{\"id\":1,\"text\":\"foo\"}]"}'
```

devon: API response: 400 Bad Request
```
{"error":"Invalid request: 'items' must be a non-empty array and 'candidates' must be an array of objects"}
```

maria: thanks — do we have the proxied request body in our logs? also any client SDK info?

devon: yes, proxied body shows exactly that: items is empty array, top_k is null, and candidates is a string (looks double-stringified). client says they're using a mobile SDK that serializes candidates internally then they JSON.stringify the whole payload again before sending.

sasha: this is a common double-encode bug. two quick things:
- server-side validation currently checks schema but returns generic message. we can improve error to say which field has the wrong type.
- recommend repro steps so eng can reproduce locally.

devon: repro I used locally (curl above) gives same 400. also tried:
```
{"items": [{"id":"q1","query":"Which is bigger?"}], "top_k": 5, "candidates": "[{\"id\":\"c1\",\"text\":\"A\"}]"}
```
-> returns 400 because candidates is string not array.

maria: can we draft a short response for support to send to customer? maybe show minimal correct payload and explain top_k must be integer.

devon: draft reply:
```
Thanks — the error looks like your client double-encoded the candidates field and sent top_k as null. Please send a payload like:
{
  "items": [{"id":"q1","query":"Which is bigger?"}],
  "top_k": 5,
  "candidates": [{"id":"c1","text":"A"}, {"id":"c2","text":"B"}]
}
```
Also: remove the extra `JSON.stringify` on the candidates array in your client.

sasha: i can add a small guard in the validation layer so if candidates is a string we attempt a single JSON.parse and return a clearer message ("candidates must be an array; looks like a JSON string — remove extra stringify"). that should reduce repeated tickets.

devon: created internal bug: SPT-4821, added repro, logs, and snippets. assigning to @eng-runtime. I'll paste a short troubleshooting checklist in the ticket.

support-bot: Ticket created: SPT-4821 by devon — rerank schema: candidates double-encoded / top_k null -> triage to eng-runtime.

maria: perfect. devon please post the proposed validation wording in the ticket so support can paste it to customers. thanks :thumbsup:

devon: done. will follow up when eng has a patch.
